Each option promises a solution, but what do they really deliver? Stripe alternatives like NOWPayments offer a range of cryptocurrencies, but they often come with hefty fees and KYC requirements. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to bypass these restrictions and provide a permanent structural alternative at the base layer.
